doc.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Future plans: playing more and Latin albums
summary: He wants to get out of the studio and play more, though he still gets called for blues solos and recently did Latin albums.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s in the future for you right now?

Well I think I want to play more. I want to get out of the studio. But I still love to do studio work and I still get called for certain kinds of work like really what I first started getting calls for, and that’s blues solos, rockin’ stuff from the ‘40s, sometimes just beautiful music, I just did a couple of Latin albums with a young producer. Latin music, and four horns, two-three Latin rhythm section, and that was fun.
